headlines.headline: Lakers franchise sale closes at a record $12 billion amid a rocky start to the season
headlines.detail: ESPN reports the Lakers' ownership sale has closed at a record $12 billion valuation for an NBA franchise, even as the team opened the preseason without Luka Doncic, whom coach JJ Redick says is out indefinitely, and with LeBron James reportedly managing chronic arthritis entering the year.

headlines.headline: 49ers stay unbeaten at 5-0, rallying past Seahawks 32-29 on two late Purdy drives
headlines.detail: Brock Purdy led two fourth-quarter scoring drives as San Francisco overcame a 26-21 deficit to beat Seattle 32-29 at Lumen Field on Sunday, improving to 5-0 and dropping the Seahawks to 3-2 in a chippy game with three Seattle turnovers.

headlines.headline: Georgia rises to No. 1 in latest AP Top 25 as Texas and Oregon tumble
headlines.detail: Georgia (6-0) moved to No. 1 with 66 first-place votes in this week's AP poll, followed by Notre Dame, Miami, Ohio State, and Indiana. Texas dropped to No. 7 after a loss, and Oregon fell out of the rankings entirely despite drawing votes.

headlines.headline: Florida tops ESPN's way-too-early preseason Top 25 as Michigan and UConn open new eras
headlines.detail: With tip-off three weeks away (Nov. 2), ESPN's preseason Top 25 projects Florida at No. 1, while KenPom's model favors Duke. Reigning champion Michigan and runner-up UConn both enter the season under heavy roster turnover, and the AP's official preseason poll has not yet been released.
